scope: Agent visual/scenario review of exact candidate screenshots, not a human study or final accessibility qualification.
findings: Open/Save controls, personal places, filename and primary/cancel actions have clear labels and distinct focus.
Compact dark dirty-work review separates source, path, explanation and four explicit choices without overlapping essential text.
Actual 150% and 3840x2160/200% show readable native typography, file icons and non-overlapping action fields.
The unsupported 1280x1024/200% request shows a clear refusal and retains the existing 100% interface.
Protected Save explains refusal while retaining the original document; feedback uses readable shared ink.

carry_forward.observation: Prior menu/conflict feedback plus background transfer conflict-review admission/arbitration require the planned integration proof; finish/cancel transfers before opening a picker.
Preserve drawn-cursor/hit isolation and reconcile the global explicit scale limit with smaller startup modes.
